traceability.notes: The story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION is fully implemented. The `require-test-traceability` rule exists, is wired into the plugin’s dynamic rule loading and presets, enforces file-level `@supports` annotations for test files, validates describe block story references via a configurable pattern, and enforces `[REQ-XXX]` prefixes on `it`/`test` names. Helper utilities implement test file detection and safe auto-fix behavior. Jest and Mocha-style APIs (`describe`, `it`, `test`, `context`) are recognized, and there are no false positives on non-test files. Documentation in README and user-docs/api-reference.md describes the rule and its options, and the dedicated Jest test suite for this rule (explicitly linked to this story via `@supports`) passes in the full test run. Dependencies on existing annotation, file, and requirement validation rules are used as intended to satisfy REQ-TEST-SUPPORTS-VALID. Accordingly, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are met with concrete, passing tests and documentation.
